newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Usko hits new yr high on continued interest.
newsitem.headline: Usko hits new yr high on continued interest.

text.p: Shares in South African copper products and conductors firm Usko Ltd on Monday continued to bask under heavy interest on Monday spurred by the selling of a stake in the firm about two weeks ago, dealers said.
By about 0905 GMT the stock was up seven cents at 82 cents with 5,2 million shares worth around 4.4 million rand exchanging hands. Usko had earlier touched a new year high at 85 cents.
"What we are seeing here (in the stock) is mixed. There is not one particular broker that did anything here, everybody is just involved in the buying and selling," one dealer said.

"(Usko) was in the news a few weeks ago when Metkor sold its stake in the firm to a consortium of buyers and I think there is still a lot interest that is still going on around that deal," the dealer added.
Usko said on June 4 that Metkor Group Ltd had sold its 27.3 percent stake in the firm, pushing the shares to higher territory in the past two weeks.

Dealers said investors were cheering the quality of the buyer's of Metkor's stake who included funds under the management of Capital Partners Ltd, Fedsure Asset Management, Genbel Securities Ltd and John Beck.
A local Sunday business newspaper recommended Usko as good buy.
"Usko is one of the most liquid shares on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange...I'd get into Usko now while it is still cheap," the paper said at the weekend.
The stock was last up eight cents to 83 cents with a volume of 5.7 million shares worth around 4.6 million rand changing hands.
